title: Desk — one Math Engine, top, supports, pedestal and modesty panel
description:
A parametric DESK on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. Against a wall segment the desk takes the wall's direction and the modesty panel faces it; Flip side turns it round, which also swaps which end the pedestal reads as.

WHAT IT BUILDS. A top, either four posts or two end panels, an optional modesty panel hung under the back edge, and an optional drawer pedestal at either end with its fronts divided up the face.

THE PEDESTAL SIDE IS ARITHMETIC, NOT A BRANCH. `_pu0 = _pedLeft ? (_u0 + _lg) : (_u1 - _lg - _pw)` is the only line that knows which end it is on; everything after — carcass, drawer fronts, the knee-space metric — is expressed in `_pu0` and does not care.

THE DRAWER DIVISION IS ONE BROADCAST. `_dz = _pz0 + arange(n) * _dh` is every front's bottom edge at once, and a 6 mm reveal is subtracted from each end of the front rather than from the pitch, so the stack always fills the carcass exactly whatever the count.

KNEE SPACE IS A REPORTED METRIC, not a drawn thing — width from the clear span between the supports minus the pedestal, height from the modesty panel's drop. Both fall out of dimensions the flow already has, which is the point of the Output Metrics node.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped; each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD and the pedestal sits inside the top's outline.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 1.40 × 0.70 m at 0.75 m high, 0.98 m² of work surface, a 0.90 m knee space 0.42 m high, three 0.223 m drawers.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. The top is rectangular — an L-shaped or corner desk is a different body. Drawer fronts are applied plates, with no carcass runners or handles modelled.

params.name: Desk maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_topT = topThk * _s
_lg = legSize * _s
_pedW = pedestalWidth * _s
_modD = modestyDrop * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_v1 = _Dp / 2
_legTop = _Ht - _topT
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Dp
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Top
_TOP = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _legTop, _Ht, 1)
# Supports — four posts or two end panels
_isLeg = support == 'Four legs'
_G1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v0 + _lg, _u0, _v0 + _lg, 0, _legTop, 2)
_G2 = hcat(_u1 - _lg, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v0 + _lg, _u1 - _lg, _v0 + _lg, 0, _legTop, 2)
_G3 = hcat(_u1 - _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u1, _v1 - _lg, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _lg, _v1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_G4 = hcat(_u0, _v1 - _lg, _u0 + _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u0 + _lg, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_PN1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_PN2 = hcat(_u1 - _lg, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _lg, _v1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_SUP = _isLeg ? vcat(_G1, _G2, _G3, _G4) : vcat(_PN1, _PN2)
# Modesty panel across the back, hanging from under the top
_MODr = hcat(_u0 + _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u1 - _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u1 - _lg, _v1, _u0 + _lg, _v1, _legTop - _modD, _legTop, 3)
_MOD = modesty > 0 ? _MODr : zeros(0, 11)
# Pedestal — a carcass at one end, with its drawer fronts spread up the face in one broadcast
_hasPed = pedestal != 'None'
_pedLeft = pedestal == 'Left'
_pw = min(_pedW, _Ln - 2 * _lg - 0.05 * _s)
_pu0 = _pedLeft ? (_u0 + _lg) : (_u1 - _lg - _pw)
_pu1 = _pu0 + _pw
_pz1 = _legTop - 0.01 * _s
_pz0 = 0.04 * _s
_PEDr = hcat(_pu0, _v0 + 0.01 * _s, _pu1, _v0 + 0.01 * _s, _pu1, _v1 - 0.01 * _s, _pu0, _v1 - 0.01 * _s, _pz0, _pz1, 4)
_PED = _hasPed ? _PEDr : zeros(0, 11)
_nd = max(1, round(drawers))
_dh = (_pz1 - _pz0) / _nd
_dz = _pz0 + arange(_nd) * _dh
_dfT = 0.018 * _s
_DFr = hcat(fill(_nd,1,_pu0), fill(_nd,1,_v0 - _dfT), fill(_nd,1,_pu1), fill(_nd,1,_v0 - _dfT), fill(_nd,1,_pu1), fill(_nd,1,_v0), fill(_nd,1,_pu0), fill(_nd,1,_v0), _dz + 0.006 * _s, _dz + _dh - 0.006 * _s, fill(_nd,1,5))
_DF = _hasPed ? _DFr : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_TOP, _SUP, _MOD, _PED, _DF)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Top3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Supports3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Modesty3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Pedestal3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Drawers3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
TopPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
SupportsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
PedestalPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DrawersPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 5)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallLength = _Ln
overallDepth = _Dp
overallHeight = _Ht
topArea = _Ln * _Dp
kneeWidth = _hasPed ? (_Ln - 2 * _lg - _pw) : (_Ln - 2 * _lg)
kneeHeight = modesty > 0 ? (_legTop - _modD) : _legTop
drawerHeight = _hasPed ? _dh : 0
footprint = _Ln * _Dp
